senses.gloss: अजि अजि, f. (fr. अज्, q. v.), a road.

1. आजि, इस्, m. f. (Ved. m.), a running-match; (आजिम्
अज् or इ or धाव् or सृ, to run with or against any
one for the prize); a fighting-match, fighting, combat,
battle, war; place for running, course, level ground;
abuse, invective; an instant; [cf. Scot. àgh, ‘fight;’
Hib. agh.]
—आजि-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. running or fight-
ing for a prize; making war.
—आजि-क्रिया, f. fighting,
making war.
—आजि-तुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, Ved. victorious
in battles.
—आजि-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the battle.
—आज्य्-अन्त, अस्, m. the goal in a race-course.
आजि 1. आजि. See under आज् above.

आजि 2. आ-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to
conquer, win, acquire: Desid. -जिगीषति, to try or
desire to conquer or win.

अजिका अजिका, f. (fr. अजा), a young goat
[cf. 1. अज].

अजित अ-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, not conquered,
unsubdued, unsurpassed, invincible, irresistible; (अस्),
m., N. of an antidote, a poisonous sort of rat; N. of
various persons, viz. Viṣṇu; Śiva; one of the Saptar-
shis of the fourteenth Manvantara; Maitreya or a future
Buddha; the second of the Arhats or saints of the
present (Jaina) Avasrapiṇī, a descendant of Ikṣvāku;
the attendant of Suvidhi, who is the ninth of those
Arhats; (आस्), m. pl. a class of deified beings in the
first Manvantara.
—अजित-केश-कम्बल, अस्, m., N.
of a Brāhman.
—अजित-बला, f., N. of a Jaina deity,
who acts under the direction of the Arhat Ajita.
—अजित-विक्रम, अस्, m. (having invincible power),
epithet of king Candragupta the second.
—अजितात्मन्
(˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having an unsubdued self or spirit.
—अजितापीड (˚त-आप्˚), अस्, m. having an unsurpassed
crown; N. of a king.
—अजितेन्द्रिय (˚त-इन्द्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, having an unsubdued sensuous nature, whose
passions are not controlled.

अजीत अ-जीत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ज्या usually
makes जीन), not faded, not faint.
—अजीत-पुनर्व-
ण्य, अम्, n., Ved. (unfaded and recoverable), N. of a
twofold rite to be performed by Kṣatriyas.

अजिन अजिन, अम्, n. (probably at first the
skin of a goat, अज, with the hair on, then any skin
which would answer the same purpose); the hairy
skin of an antelope, especially a black antelope,
which serves the religious student for a couch, seat,
[]
covering, &c.; the hairy skin of a tiger, &c.; (अस्),
m., N. of a descendant of Pṛthu.
—अजिन-पत्त्रा or
अजिन-पत्त्री or अजिन-पत्त्रिका, f. a bat.
—अजिन-
फला, f., N. of a plant (?).
—अजिन-योनि, इस्, m.
(origin of the skin), an antelope, deer.
—अजिन-
वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, clad in a skin.
—अजिन-सन्ध,
अस्, m. (who joins or prepares skins), a furrier.

अजिर अजिर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अज्), agile,
quick, rapid; (अस्), m., N. of a snake priest; (आ),
f., N. of Durgā, and of a river; (अम्), n. place to run
or fight in, area, court [Lat. ager?]; the body; any
object of sense, air, wind; a frog; (अम्), ind. quickly.
—अजिर-वती, f., N. of the river on which the town
Śrāvasti was situated.
—अजिर-शोचिस्, इस्, m., Ved.
having a quick light, glittering, epithet of Agni and
Soma.
—अजिराधिराज (˚र-अध्˚), अस्, m., Ved. an
agile emperor, epithet of death.

अजिराय, nom. A. अजिरायते, -यितुम्, Ved. to be
agile or quick.

अजिरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, connected (by proximity or
ownership &c.) with an ajira or court &c.

अजिह्म अ-जिह्म, अस्, आ, अम्, not crooked,
straight, straightforward, upright; (अस्), m. a frog, a
fish; see अ-जिह्व, of which this may be a corruption.
—अजिह्म-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going straight on; (अस्),
m. an arrow.
—अजिह्माग्र (˚ह्म-अग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having a straight point.

अजिह्व अ-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, tongueless;
(अस्), m. a frog.

अजीकव अजीकव, अम्, n. Śiva's bow. See
अजकव.

अजीगर्त अ-जीगर्त, अस्, m. (that has nothing
to swallow), N. of a Ṛṣi, Śunaḥśepha's father.

अ-जीति, इस्, f., Ved. unfadingness; freedom from decay,
prosperity.

अजीर्ण अ-जीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जॄ), not de-
composed; unimpaired; undigested; (अम्), n. free-
dom from decay, indigestion.
अ-जीर्णि, इस्, f. indigestion.
अ-जीर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from indigestion.

अजीव अ-जीव, अस्, m. (non-life), non-ex-
istence, death; (अस्, आ, अम्), lifeless.

आ-जीव, अस्, m. livelihood, subsistence; a Jaina
beggar.

अ-जीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not living, destitute of a
livelihood.

अ-जीवन, अम्, n. non-existence, death; (अस्, आ,
अम्), destitute of a livelihood.

आ-जीवन, अम्, n. livelihood, subsistence.
—आजीव-
नार्थ (˚न-अर्˚), अस्, m. (अम्, n. ?) means of live-
lihood or subsistence, business, profession.

अ-जीवनि, इस्, f. non-existence, death; अजीवनिस्
तस्य भूयात्, ‘may death befal him!’
अ-जीवित, अम्, n. non-existence, death.

आ-जिगीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, ambitious, wishing to excel
or overcome.

आजिग्रह आ-जिग्रह, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ग्रह्),
who or what takes or seizes.

आजिज्ञासेन्य आ-जिज्ञासेन्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr.
Desid. of rt. ज्ञा with आ), Ved. liable to investigation;
(आस्), f. pl., N. of a short section of the Kuntāpa
hymns in the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa; (the word ऋचस्
must be supplied.)
आजीकूल आजीकूल, N. of a region.

आजीगर्ति आजीगर्ति, a patronymic fr. अजी-
गर्त.

आजीव् आ-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -वितुम्, to
live by; to have the use or enjoyment of; to subsist.

आ-जीवक, अस्, m. a beggar, one who obtains his
livelihood everywhere.

आ-जीविन्, ई, m. having a livelihood; a peculiar kind
of beggar.

आ-जीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be practised as a means of
living; fit for or affording a livelihood; habitable,
fertile; fruitful; (अम्), n. means of living.
